brief.headline: Customer feedback needs attention
brief.summary: 50 reviews were analyzed in the latest 30-day window with an average rating of 3.44.
recommended_actions: Review staffing and kitchen throughput during the busiest service periods.
Review service standards and identify when customer attention breaks down.
Increase front-of-house and washroom cleanliness checks during peak periods.
